title: Migrate a standalone project
description: Copy an existing project into the workspace, the source never modified: a standalone Angular CLI, Ionic/Capacitor or Flutter app as apps/<name>, or the Angular, Ionic and Flutter projects of an Nx 15-17 workspace at their own paths. With rollback=<name>, undo a migration.

source.description: Path to the source repo root (absolute, or relative to the current directory). Read only.

name.description: App name for single-app sources, report name (docs/migrations/<name>.md) for Nx sources; kebab-case.

adapter.description: Skip detection and use this adapter: a built-in id (angular-cli, flutter, nx-workspace, angular-workspace, ionic, npm-workspaces) or an adapter listed in nx.json pstack.migrateAdapters.

detect.description: Print the detection table (adapter, confidence, reasons) and exit without writing anything.

projects.description: Nx sources: comma-separated project names to migrate (default: every supported project). The libs they need are added unless noDeps.

noDeps.description: Nx sources: copy only the projects named in projects, not the libs they need.

prefix.description: Nx sources: rename migrated projects to <prefix>-<name> (paths and import aliases are kept).

maxFiles.description: Fail when more files than this would be copied (after the skip lists).

forceAngular.description: Proceed when the workspace and the source use different Angular major versions (the report flags the mismatch).

rollback.description: Undo the migration recorded in docs/migrations/<name>.manifest.json (v0.13.0+). Use instead of source.

force.description: With rollback: also remove or restore files and settings that changed after the migration.

config.description: Run the migrations listed in this JSON batch file, all or nothing (v0.14.0+). Use instead of source.

minConfidence.description: Use the best adapter when its confidence reaches this value (0.5 to 1; default 0.8). Not with adapter.

dir.description: Single-app sources: put the app in apps/<dir>/<name>, e.g. legacy or legacy/web (v0.16.0+).

rewriteImports.description: Rewrite imports in the copied code: relative imports into another moved project, imports through the source baseUrl, @nrwl/* packages and SCSS paths (v0.21.0+). The source is never changed.

newAdapter.description: Write a starter adapter tools/migrate/<name>.adapter.ts (with a spec), and list it in nx.json pstack.migrateAdapters (v0.22.0+). Takes no other option.
